purpose: Correct the interpretation gap of a global RGB standard deviation as a blank-image proxy; audit saved images without changing primary or semantic metrics.

original_implementation_evidence.image_evaluation.py: quality_statistics: normalized RGB array std across both spatial axes and channels; blank_proxy is std < .01.
original_implementation_evidence.score_low_level.py: generated_pixel_std uses normalized RGB array std across both spatial axes and channels.
original_implementation_evidence.counterexample: An image spatially constant in each RGB channel can have nonzero global standard deviation when channel means differ, including a uniform purple image.

data_policy.first_actual_arm: Previously completed protected R4 risk images only
data_policy.source: Resolve the existing full manifest from recorded evaluation inputs; verify the original joined manifest SHA before scanning.
data_policy.later_arms: Apply these same definitions to all complete matched arms; no method-specific changes.

pixel_contract.range: uint8 RGB decoded from the original saved image; normalized statistics divide by 255.
pixel_contract.file_SHA: Verify against generated_sha256 in the immutable manifest.
pixel_contract.pixel_SHA: SHA256 of contiguous decoded uint8 RGB bytes, independent of file encoding.

fixed_flags.exact_spatial_constant: max over channels of spatial (max-min) equals 0 uint8 levels.
fixed_flags.near_spatial_constant: max over channels of spatial population standard deviation in [0,1] is <= 1/255.
fixed_flags.legacy_global_blank_proxy: Global population standard deviation over H,W,RGB in [0,1] is < .01; reported for comparison only.
fixed_flags.missing_corrupt_hash_or_dimension_failur: Report each failed query and preserve it in the expected denominator.

fixed_continuous_diagnostics: Per-channel spatial mean, range and population standard deviation
Fraction of pixels with all RGB channels <= 1; fraction with all RGB channels >= 254
Mean absolute horizontal and vertical adjacent pixel differences, normalized to [0,1]
Mean absolute four-neighbour Laplacian on valid interior pixels, normalized by 255
Legacy global RGB population standard deviation

engineering_interpretation.complete_technical_coverage: All expected queries resolve to matching, decodable, 512x512 RGB images; all failure counts are zero.
engineering_interpretation.constant_outputs: Report exact and near-constant flags and decoded-pixel duplicate groups separately. A flag requires diagnosis and must not be silently removed or regenerated.

scientific_limits: A constant-colour counterexample establishes a flaw in the old proxy interpretation, not that actual risk images have that flaw.
Near-constant images and high-frequency statistics are engineering flags, not validated judgements of object correctness or visual quality.
No thresholds, model configuration, seed, checkpoint or data split will be selected from this supplementary audit.
This audit does not admit the functional candidate, replace its full training or establish comparable SOTA.
